Published use of AFNI for fMRI

?

A community of users. This map shows published fMRI papers whose methods sections list the software AFNI (Analysis of Functional NeuroImages) among their tools. The circles are placed at the institution of the corresponding author, and the circle's area is proportional to the number of papers published within the range of years selected.

Data sources. Papers: Europe PMC. Corresponding authors, institutions and locations: OpenAlex.

Search filters. A paper's methods section contained "AFNI", "afni_proc" or "afni_proc.py", and the paper also mentions "fMRI", "functional MRI", "functional magnetic resonance imaging", "EPI", "echo planar imaging" or "BOLD", and was published between 1996–2026. Note that preprints are excluded, and the search mechanisms did not locate papers published before 1999. Across all years some published work may have been missed.

Counting. Each paper counts once, for the first listed institution of its first corresponding author. Institutions within 2 km are combined into one circle ("+N nearby").

Caveats. Only open-access full texts are searched, so counts understate use, especially in earlier years. Listing AFNI does not necessarily mean it was the main analysis tool.

Map use. Hover a circle for details, click it for links to the papers, scroll to zoom, drag to pan.

By Salvatore (Sam) Torrisi + Claude Sonnet. Last update: November 10, 2026.
